CKA seq 8 re-examines the 9/10 eyewitness pattern. Host surfaces GMA interview with Tiffany Barker and her later artery-explanation video, then walks a timeline placing George Zinn's arrest inside ~1:48 of the SUV departure. She highlights a Wirefy-branded individual filming immediately post-shot, and traces a viral roof-shooter video through Chicago-based phone numbers before speaking to an eyewitness whose metadata at 12:22–12:23 contradicts the FBI's public shooter description (tactical gear vs jeans/flag shirt). She then plays Andrew Kolvet's Alex Clark interview (Catholic conversion, $150M Israel, SD cards, moral blackmail) and a Charlie Kirk Myrtle Beach clip on moral blackmail. Closes with a Trump audio statement on splitting MMR and delaying Hepatitis B.
